I am 73 years old, been on this small piece of land for 50 years. Only 2.6 mu, just me and my wife at home now. My back is not what it used to be, but cotton I know — my hands know it.

This year like every year, I plant cotton. Same as before. I buy the Bt cotton seed from the dealer in town — the kind that fights the bollworm by itself. Everyone around here uses this kind now, maybe 20 years already. Old seeds I don't use anymore, bollworm eats them up.

For fertilizer, before planting I spread diammonium phosphate — about one bag (50 jin, 25 kg) for my 2.6 mu, so maybe 10 kg per mu. Then urea I put twice — once when cotton starts to have buds, once when it flowers. Each time maybe half a bag, so total urea about 25-30 kg across the season for all my land, which is around 10-12 kg per mu. I also put some potassium, one small bag, because the dealer said cotton needs it for the bolls to fill. Maybe 5 kg per mu.

I figure nitrogen total: the DAP has some nitrogen, plus urea. Around 15 kg N per mu. Phosphorus from DAP, around 5 kg per mu. Potassium around 5 kg per mu.

Water — I have my own well, thank heaven. I water after planting to help it come up, then when buds come, when flowers come, and when bolls are filling. Four times usually. If rain comes good I skip one.

Pesticide — Bt cotton handles bollworm but aphids and mites still come. I spray maybe 4-5 times through the season. Also spray against red spider when it's hot and dry.

I plough the land before planting with the small tractor I hire from my nephew — costs me some money but my body can't turn soil anymore.

Yield — good year I get 250 kg of seed cotton per mu, bad year 200. I expect around 230 kg per mu.
